_readme: THE ONE FILE TO EDIT for the mobile apps. After changing anything here run:  npm run sync   (see MOBILE_APP_GUIDE.md)
_version_readme: Raise 'build' by 1 every time you upload a new app to Google Play / App Store. 'version' is what people see. Website changes do NOT need a new version.
_releaseNotes_readme: One short sentence shown in the app's 'Update available' message. Change it with each app release.
releaseNotes: Works offline: your lessons open without internet, and an Update message tells you about new versions.
_devUrl_readme: TESTING ONLY. Put your computer's local Django address here (e.g. http://192.168.1.5:8000) to test the app against `runserver`. Leave it EMPTY ("") before building for the stores. See MOBILE_APP_GUIDE.md, section 4.
_hosts_readme: Web addresses that open INSIDE the app. Every other address opens in the in-app browser.
_payment_hosts_readme: Payment pages allowed inside the Android app (only used if you allow payments in the app; see the guide).
_deeplinks_readme: Links to your website (e.g. from WhatsApp or email) open straight in the app. Needs the two Django settings in the guide, section 7.
_permissions_readme: The sentences iPhone shows when the app first asks for the microphone / camera. Apple rejects vague wording, so say exactly why.

permissionText.microphone: Diction Masters uses the microphone so you can record yourself speaking and get feedback on your pronunciation.
permissionText.camera: Diction Masters uses the camera to scan the QR codes printed in your EchoSpell books.
permissionText.photos: Diction Masters saves QR codes and images you choose to download to your photo library.

_background_audio_readme: true = Diction Radio and lesson audio keep playing when the phone is locked (iPhone).
_ios_bound_readme: true = offline lessons and saved videos work on iPhone (service worker). Set false only if Apple review or a payment page needs other websites inside the app.
